access.notes: Structures: γ-TiAl (L1₀, P4/mmm, a≈4.0 Å, c≈4.07 Å, c/a~1.018), α2-Ti3Al (D0₁₉, P6₃/mmc, a≈5.78 Å, c≈4.67 Å, c/a~0.809). Atomic positions are standard; agent constructs unit cells from these parameters.
